summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K with an extraordinary general shareholders meeting call for 14-15 December 2026 (expected second call), seeking approval of non-cash share capital increases to fund exchange offers announced 30 July 2026 to acquire all Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. securities not held by Santander Group. Four tranches (1A-1D) cover the initial and subsequent offering periods with possible incomplete subscription. No price per share or premium disclosed. Board recommends approval. Watch take-up levels, Brazilian minority response, and capital dilution from the new shares.
